description: List the filters this server will actually enforce on a search - budget ceilings, condition, brand, and the vertical-specific keys (mileage, drive size) plus any x_* extensions. Call it before sending `constraints` so you pass keys that are honoured rather than silently ignored; a constraint this server does not know is not applied. Free, instant, no side effects. Protocol v1.0 §8.2.
name: demand.list_constraints

constraints.description: Every constraint key that can be enforced on a search or want.

operators.description: Comparisons this key accepts, e.g. lte, eq, in.

title: List the constraint vocabulary
